generic_lessons: A popup callback can run while its parent is hidden. Observe the actual GUI; opening the existing parent is distinct from repeating the prompt.
Separate a successful main-menu transition from application exit.
Pre-host player configuration fields do not establish actual runtime ownership or leader.
Use original parameter consumers with actual candidates; setup readiness is not game behavior proof.
